children: Independence Realty Trust reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $172.1 million, up 3% from a year earlier, and net income attributable to common shares of $25.1 million, compared with $6.9 million. Earnings included a $26.5 million gain on a property sale.
Revenue was $172.1M, compared with $167.1M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 3.0%.
Net income attributable to common shares was $25.1M, compared with $6.9M in the prior-year quarter.
Diluted EPS was $0.11, compared with $0.03 in the prior-year quarter.
The company owned and operated 115 communities with 33,398 units across 12 states at quarter-end; occupancy was 94.9%.
Same-store revenue increased 2.0% year over year, while same-store net operating income rose 1.6%.
Independence Realty Trust acquired a 140-unit community in Columbus in January and sold a Memphis property in September. The sale generated a $26.5 million gain.
A 378-unit Austin property remained in lease-up. The company completed renovations on 744 units during the quarter and had renovated 13,212 program units to date.
The proposed merger with Centerspace is expected to close as early as late 2026, subject to approvals and other closing conditions.
